scripts.text:
[Nillem]
What are you doing here?
That's right, I'm waiting for a strong adventurer to satisfy my curiosity!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你在這裡做什麼？
沒錯，我在等待一位強大的冒險者，好滿足我的好奇心！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
If you reach level 175, you will be my destined opponent-��
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
如果你達到175級，你就是我命中註定的對手了——

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I think I've made a great discovery, so why don't you come with me?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我覺得我有了個重大發現，你願意跟我一起去看看嗎？

scripts.text: Let's go!
scripts.translation: 出發吧！

scripts.text: Please explain it.
scripts.translation: 請解釋一下

scripts.text: What I found
scripts.translation: 我發現了什麼

scripts.text: Refuse.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
This is my bae!
You're gonna jump into the abyss with me! I can't help But L-O-V-E you.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
這是我的寶貝！
你要和我一起跳進深淵！我忍不住愛你啊。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
As you know, I'm a good court wizard, right?
A genius wizard who can do this and that on dimension!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
你知道的，我是一位優秀的宮廷巫師，對吧？
一位能在維度上施展各種法術的天才巫師！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
There was a report of strange magical power near central castle of Glast Heim.
I came here to investigate and found it.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
有報告稱葛拉斯特海姆中央城堡附近出現了奇怪的魔力。
我來這裡調查，並找到了它。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
A week crack of dimension!
You know, this genius wizard is good at connecting the crack of dimensions.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
一道維度的裂縫！
你知道的，這位天才巫師擅長連線維度裂縫。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
So I forced the connection and went in....
A piece of time that has stopped in the flow.... Hmmm... It's so hard to explain..
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
所以我強行連線了進去……
一段在時間洪流中停滯的片段……嗯……很難解釋……

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Anyway, the flood of creatures trapped for a long time came to me like waves!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
總之，那些被囚禁了很久的生物像波浪一樣向我湧來！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I almost D - i - e - d there.
So I'm looking for adventurers to join me on this expedition.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
我差點就死在那裡了。
所以我正在尋找冒險者加入這次探險。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Right, there's no mission here, but curiosity follows discovery!
You noticed before I told you there were a few things I wanted to do with you, My - Darling -.
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，這裡沒有任務，但好奇心驅使著發現！
在我告訴你之前，你注意到了吧，我有幾件事想和你一起做，親愛的。

scripts.text: An Empty Thing
scripts.translation: 空無一物

scripts.text: A Thing with High Freezing Point
scripts.translation: 高凝固點物體

scripts.text: A Thing Like A Mirror
scripts.translation: 像鏡子一樣的東西

scripts.text: Well, I'm okay.
scripts.translation: 我沒事

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Beyond the cracks of this dimension, there are Empty Things..
^0000FFContaminated Raydric^000000 and ^0000FFContaminated Raydric Archer^000000...
Contamination
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
在這個維度的裂縫之外，有“空無一物”……
^0000FF被汙染的幽靈劍士^000000和^0000FF被汙染的幽靈弓箭手^000000……
汙染

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
^0000FF20 Contaminated Raydrics^000000,
^0000FF20 Contaminated Raydric Archers^000000!! Defeat them and come back. Then this genius wizard will study it.
What do you think, bae?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
^0000FF20只被汙染的幽靈劍士^000000，
^0000FF20只被汙染的幽靈弓箭手^000000！擊敗它們然後回來。這位天才巫師會研究它們的。
你覺得怎麼樣，寶貝？

scripts.text: That's not hard.
scripts.translation: 這不難

scripts.text: I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
If you're busy, you can't help me.
But honey, please help me when You - Have - Spare - Time - !
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
如果你很忙，就沒法幫我了。
但是親愛的，等你 - 有 - 空 - 的 - 時 - 候 - ，請一定要幫我哦！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
I asked you too much today, Sweetie.
Instead, you're sharing another new discovery tomorrow. O - K - A - Y -?
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
今天麻煩你太多了，親愛的。
明天我會分享另一個新發現。好 - 吧 - ？

scripts.text:
^4d4dff - You can take this mission again. Speak to Mage Nillem once again to accept it. - ^000000
[Nillem]
That's my baby!
It's hard to see the impact there because of the strange magic.
If you finish the quest, let's get out of there first And - Then Check - !
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff - 你可以再次接受這個任務。再次與魔法師尼勒姆對話即可接受。 - ^000000
[尼勒姆]
真是我的寶貝！
因為奇怪的魔法，很難看清那裡的影響。
如果你完成了任務，我們先離開那裡，然後 - 再 - 檢 - 查 - ！

scripts.translation:

^0000FF20只被汙染的幽靈弓箭手^000000。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff - You can take this mission again. Speak to Mage Nillem once again to accept it. - ^000000

Ha~ It's so obvious out here. Could you please show me your... weapon and... armor? Hmm...
Hmmm!!
Haha, what a discovery of the century!
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff - 你可以再次接受這個任務。再次與魔法師尼勒姆對話即可接受。 - ^000000
[尼勒姆]
哈~ 在外面看很明顯。能給我看看你的...武器和...盔甲嗎？嗯...
嗯！！
哈哈，這可是世紀大發現啊！

在這個維度的裂縫之外，有彼此互為映象的東西。

Do - Not - Push - yourself --- !
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
好了，好了，親愛的，你說得對。
如果你累了，就休息一下。
不 - 要 - 逼 - 自 - 己 - ！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Oh, my sweetheart, you're so mean today.
Nillem is saaaad. *Tears*
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哎呀，親愛的，你今天真狠心。
尼勒姆好傷心。*眼淚*

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Woo-hoo! I'm so excited whenever I come here!
I love this bleakness!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
哇哦！每次來這裡我都好興奮！
我喜歡這種荒涼的感覺！

scripts.text: Let's get out of here!
scripts.translation: 讓我們離開這裡！

scripts.text: I'd like to look around.
scripts.translation: 我想四處看看

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
See you!
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
再見啦！

scripts.text:
[Nillem]
Sure!
Let's - Go - Out - Side - !
scripts.translation:
[尼勒姆]
當然！
我 - 們 - 去 - 外 - 面 - 吧 - ！

scripts.text:
[Lily]
...?
...well, I don't think the guards will let you in...
scripts.translation:
[莉莉]
...？
...我想衛兵不會讓你進去的...

scripts.text:
[Lily]
If you are qualified to enter the 3rd floor of Nogg Road, would you accept a quest?
We need a lot of work.
The guards said level 175 is enough...
scripts.translation:
[莉莉]
如果你符合進入諾格路第三層的資格，願意接受一個任務嗎？
我們需要很多工作。
衛兵說175級就足夠了...

scripts.text:
[Lily]
Friendly adventurer, would you mind helping us with the research for our conference report?
Only an adventurer's eye is the only way for us to live.
scripts.translation:
[莉莉]
友好的冒險者，你介意幫我們做一下會議報告的研究嗎？
只有冒險者的視角才能讓我們生存下去。

scripts.text: Listen to the request
scripts.translation: 聽聽他的請求

scripts.text: Suspicious...
scripts.translation: 可疑...

scripts.text: Reject

小心點，它們很危險。

scripts.text:
[Sally]
Um? That's to be a full-time employee!
Not long ago, I joined Regenschrum as a trainee researcher, but this is what I was appointed for.
It's about collecting data on mining monsters, so my evaluation depends on that.
scripts.translation:
[莎莉]
嗯？那是為了成為正式員工！
不久前，我作為學員研究員加入了Regenschrum，但這就是我得到的任命。
這是關於收集礦坑魔物資料的工作，我的評價取決於此。

scripts.text:
[Sally]
And there were constant complaints from the headquarters asking what to do with the mine monsters.
While collecting data, it also regulates the number of individuals. This evaluation is a win-win, a win-win!
scripts.translation:
[莎莉]
總部一直不斷抱怨，問該如何處理礦坑裡的魔物。
在收集資料的同時，也能控制魔物的數量。這次評估可是雙贏，雙贏啊！

scripts.text:
[Olive]
The orders keep pouring in, and everyone who works there is running away... It's a big deal, a big deal.
scripts.translation:
[奧莉薇]
訂單像潮水般湧來，在那兒工作的人都紛紛逃跑了...這可是件大事，大事啊。

scripts.text:
[Atri]
After all, it would be faster for me to learn the sword! I've only been picking a pickaxe for 10 years, so I'll learn it soon.
scripts.translation:
[阿特里]
畢竟，我學劍術會更快！
我挖了10年礦，學劍術肯定很快就能上手。
